# The C++ linters the pre-commit workflow installs, pinned so a new release never changes what CI
# asks of the code by surprise. Dependabot proposes each upgrade as a pull request; the workflow
# then checks every file with the new versions, so that pull request shows what they flag.

cpplint==2.0.2
